name: STAR GLITCHER ~ REVITALIZED
desc:
(WARNING: This game has a lot of flashing lights.)

Welcome to Star Glitcher ~ Revitalized!

You ventured out into space and came into contact with a weird-looking planet labeled "Axuremn". 
Now you're waking up with a star implanted in your chest and glowing wings by your sides.
Things are quite unpredictable out there.. so be sure to adapt or else you might just lose your mind!

(This game is an experimental non-linear+semi-sandbox RPG/Combat game where you can progress to be stronger from various means, such as fighting bosses found within the game)
For extra info on how to play, consult the terminal found in spawn.

CONSOLE/GAMEPAD CONTROLS:
[Y/Triangle] = M1
[LT/L2] = Z
[LB/L1] = X
[RB/R1] = C
[RT/R2] = V
[B/Circle] = Ult 
[X/Square] = Sprint
[Up] = Taunt

[LeftThumbstick] = Open/Close Mode_Wheel
[LeftThumbstick/RightThumbstick] = Select Mode
[Right] = B submode
[Down] = N submode
[Left] = M submode
